sufficient_sets.text: A lunar eclipse, also called a blood moon, is an astronomical event that occurs when the Moon orbits through Earth's shadow.
Lunar eclipses occur during eclipse season, when the Moon's orbital plane is approximately in line with Earth and the Sun.
